why: THE ONE CROSS-LANGUAGE DIVERGENCE. Postgres lowercases U+0130 (Turkish dotted capital I) to a bare `i`; JavaScript expands it to `i` + U+0307 and the combining mark becomes a space. Found by a full-BMP sweep — every other single codepoint agrees. Recorded with both keys so the limit is a committed fact rather than a sentence in a comment: for such a label the browser would miss the existing row, save `again`, and the generated column would merge it onto the old one, silently overwriting a differently-keyed question. Accepted because English boards are the stated scope.
